name: tree-nav
title: Tree nav
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Navigation card with a person header, nested rows, counts, a guide line, and a keyboard tree.

meta.descriptionEs: Tarjeta con encabezado, carpetas anidadas, conteos y una línea guía. Se maneja con el teclado.

examples.title: Árbol de navegación
examples.description: Encabezado, carpetas con conteo y la fila Browse all.

meta.usage:
<TreeNav
  label="Projects"
  items={items}
  header={<TreeNavHeader name="Morgan Lee" role="Product Designer" />}
  defaultExpanded={["updates"]}
  onSelect={(node) => setSelected(node)}
  onAddNew={() => addItem()}
/>

api.name: items
api.description: id, label, icon, count, children, href, and disabled. Any depth.

api.name: expanded / defaultExpanded / onExpandedChange
api.description: Open folder ids. Omit expanded for internal state.

api.name: selected / defaultSelected / onSelect
api.description: Selected row. onSelect receives the node.

api.name: renderIcon / renderLink
api.description: Replace the folder or file icon. renderLink returns the row element, such as a Next.js link, and must render the props it receives.

api.name: header / footer / onAddNew / addLabel
api.description: Slots around the tree. TreeNavHeader is the person row. onAddNew renders the Add new button.

api.name: label / className
api.description: Accessible name of the tree, default Navigation, and the card class.

docs: Clean-room behavior inspired by a Design & Code With AV reel. No premium code, class names, colors, or Bootstrap Icons were copied. This is a navigation card, separate from tree-view, which is a file tree without the header, counts, or guide line. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite avatar or button. The item ships no theme. Rows follow the WAI-ARIA tree pattern. With reduced motion the chevron and the branch height do not animate. A row with href renders an anchor; pass renderLink for a router link.
